name: orth
expr: Q = orth(A); orth_err = max(max(abs(Q'*Q - eye(3)))); QB = orth(B); szb1 = size(QB,1); szb2 = size(QB,2);
comment: Sig: Q = orth(A[, tol]). Orthonormal basis for range of A; Q has rank(A) columns. Q'*Q = I exactly. Note: column signs may differ from MATLAB (singular vector sign ambiguity); fingerprint avoids direct value comparison.
